title: cardamine prorepens subsp. roseiflora
intro: Cardamine prorepens subsp. roseiflora, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae, is a subspecies of the Cardamine prorepens plant. It is also known as rose-flowered bitter-cress or rose-flowered wintercress. This plant is used for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Cardamine prorepens subsp. roseiflora include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and other compounds that may exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
